arxiv-1906-05609.title: Search for a heavy charged boson in events with a charged lepton and missing transverse momentum from p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1906-05609.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1906-05609.description: Abstract A search for a heavy charged-boson resonance decaying into a charged lepton (electron or muon) and a neutrino is reported. A data sample of 139 fb -1 of proton–proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV collected with the ATLAS detector at the LHC during 2015–2018 is used in the search.

arxiv-2104-09798.title: CoDR: Computation and Data Reuse Aware CNN Accelerator
arxiv-2104-09798.creator: Alireza Khadem, Haojie Ye, and Trevor Mudge
arxiv-2104-09798.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alireza Khadem, Haojie Ye, and Trevor Mudge. Co mputation and D ata R euse is critical for the resource-limited Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) accelerators. This paper presents Universal Computation Reuse to exploit weight sparsity, repetition, and similarity simultaneously in a convolutional layer. Moreover, CoDR decreases the cost of weight memory access by proposing a customized Run-Length Encoding scheme and the number of memory accesses to the intermediate results by introducing an input and output stationary dataflow.

arxiv-2504-14914.description: Abstract Despite its scientific importance, the low-surface-brightness universe has yet to be fully explored due to various systematic uncertainties that affect the achievable surface-brightness limit. pmc-13446120.creator: Min Sheng, Siqi Wang, Tiefeng Song, Juyong Zhao, Cancan Xia, Huanle He, Junsong Pan, Jian Pan, Haifan Wen
pmc-13446120.description: Chlorophyll, the pigment in plant leaves, is crucial for capturing light during photosynthesis. uslaw-usc-t15-s1844.title: 15 U.S.C. § 1844 — Security for loan guarantees
uslaw-usc-t15-s1844.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s1844.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 45 (Emergency Loan Guarantees To Business Enterprises). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In negotiating a loan guarantee under this chapter, the Board shall make every effort to arrange that the payment of the principal of and interest on any plan guaranteed shall be secured by sufficient property of the enterprise to collateralize fully.
